name: simple-mailer-project
description: Project root for simple-mailer. Docs and README live here; the library package lives in ./simple-mailer and the CLI (`cmailer`) lives in ./cmailer. Run the CLI from this folder.
author: CEGAANA (https://cegaana.org)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace simple-mailer && npm run build --workspace cmailer
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace simple-mailer && npm run typecheck --workspace cmailer
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace simple-mailer && npm run lint --workspace cmailer
scripts.test: npm test --workspace simple-mailer && npm test --workspace cmailer
